Data.subject: Statistical Performance Monitoring
Data.title: Statistical Capacity Indicators, Annual
Data.datasource: UNITED NATIONS GLOBAL SDG INDICATORS DATABASE, OPEN DATA WATCH, WORLD BANK
Data.footnote: Please refer to information on Open Data Inventory (ODIN) and Statistical Performance Indicators (SPI) at ODIN's Open Data Watch and World Bank's SPI websites respectively. Data are used for SDG 17.18.1 'Statistical capacity indicator for Sustainable Development Goal monitoring'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 17.18.1.

row.footnote: Data refer to the availability of important statistical indicators in 22 categories of social, economic, and environmental statistics.  There are no data for 2019 and 2021 as Open Data Watch did not conduct the ODIN assessment in these years.

Data are based on the Statistical Performance Indicators (SPI) Pillar 4 index and is a composite measure of whether countries have data available from (i) censuses and surveys, (ii) administrative data, and (iii) geospatial data.

Data are based on the Statistical Performance Indicators (SPI) Pillar 5 index and refer to the capability of the statistical system.  It measures standards and methods addressing compliance with recognised frameworks and concepts.
